description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures a trained HSTU recommender through the host ModelView interface and produces an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions.
motivation: Guide model improvements using reproducible diagnostics while preserving benchmark comparability, preventing unsupported claims about unavailable user traits or metadata, and maintaining one trained model per category.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics and metric_definitions. Use the actual view.model and preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data compatibility. Handle B x L left-padded tensors with padding masks and final-nonpadding readout, never count-1. Use only available interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; treat unavailable attributes as unobserved. Produce full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five real training users per category. Select changes using host-measured macro validation HR@10 across all four categories. Preserve HSTU, fixed seeds and training limits, and checkpoint/predictor consistency. No measured results are supplied.

originality.positive: Combines architecture-aware diagnostics with explicit data-availability and benchmark constraints.
originality.negative: Primarily an interface and evaluation discipline; it introduces no new learning algorithm or concrete diagnostic metric.

future_potential.positive: Could support systematic diagnosis and targeted HSTU improvements under a consistent validation objective.
future_potential.negative: Its usefulness depends on selecting informative probes and verifying proposed improvements through controlled validation.

code_difficulty.positive: The required entry points and batch interfaces are clearly specified.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, HSTU feature handling, full-catalog scoring, and preservation of model state require careful integration.
